lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You didn't see a bra or panties, underw underpants?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How did he tie her? What configuration? You know what I mean?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did he tie her hands in the front, back, arms, feet, tell me how he tied her up.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Tied her hands in the front. Did he tie her feet together?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did he tie anything else together?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You said that he took the ri..the rifle down? The gun?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you carry the gun out in the garage?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: So you want us to believe that he carried a body and a gun at the same time out into the garage.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Ain't that nearly impossible to do unless you gave her the gun and then you carried the body?
